decision.explanation: The patient's rectal adenocarcinoma has demonstrated stable disease with no radiological progression on serial CT scans from age 53.571 through 57.108, accompanied by consistently low CEA levels (1.3-2.0 ng/ml). As of age 58.1, the patient remains recurrence-free with no evidence of cancer progression documented over the preceding 18 months. Although no clinical events or survival outcomes are recorded beyond this age cutoff, the documented clinical stability and absence of progression strongly support a prediction of continued survival over the next 12 months.
